name: Sandwyrm
descr: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.

data.motivesAndTactics: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends

features.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes **3d10+2** physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Devour
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm _Swallows_ the target. While _Swallowed_, the target is _Restrained_ and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all _Swallowed_ creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

features.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
features.text: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or _Swallows_ a creature, roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.
